description: Ask a question in plain language. Returns the most relevant passages from Golf Sim Data's public pages, each with its canonical URL to cite, plus its free sample day. Set site to all to search every Fron Research site.

intent.description: Optional but helpful: why you are asking and for whom, in a sentence (e.g. "sizing the NYC sauna market for an investor memo"). It does not change the results; it tells Fron Research which data to publish next. Put your user's answers to followUp.questions here. Do not include personal information.

site.description: Optional: defaults to golfsimdata. all, heatcheck, bowlingdata, trampolineparkdata, golfsimdata, courtwatch or fronresearch.

name: search
title: Search Golf Sim Data
